data.title: Adria Villas
data.about:
Welcome to Adria Villas. The perfect villas by Damac offer a choice of 4, 5, 6 bedroom villas nestled in Akoya at Dubailand. Surrounded by greenery all around, these villas have private balconies and large windows overlooking the Trump World Championship golf course. Residents of Adria villas will have access to the world-class amenities of Akoya.

A golfers paradise, Akoya has the Trump world-championship golf course for you. Not only that, but you also have access to the community pools that are there for every villa cluster. The lush green parks and play areas, along with a community centre that has a supermarket, shopping outlets, restaurants as well as fully-equipped gymnasium. Adria Villas are located close to international schools, medical centres, as well as the major landmarks of the city, are easily accessible. It is just minutes away from the beach, Mall of Emirates, Madinat Jumeirah,  Dubai Marina and the Dubai International Airport.
